references.text: Luke 4:11 is a direct quote from Psalm 91:12, which states that God's angels will carry you in their hands so that you do not strike your foot against any stone. The devil quotes this verse to tempt Jesus to throw himself down from the temple wall.
The broader context of Psalm 91:11-12 concerns God's protection through His angels. The devil uses this promise out of context to tempt Jesus.
Matthew 4:6 contains the parallel account of the same temptation, where the devil quotes the same passage from Psalm 91 and challenges Jesus to throw himself down from the temple pinnacle.
